dosing.evidence: received a single ICV injection of 1 µL 5-MeO-DMT solution (100 µg 5-MeO-DMT in 10% DMSO/90% saline) prepared fresh ... control groups received 1 µL of 10% DMSO in saline

judge_notes: Paper contains no behavioural assays — all endpoints are histological (BrdU, DCX::tdTom counts, Sholl/dendritic morphology) or ex vivo slice electrophysiology (whole-cell patch clamp). Per rubric, these are explicitly excluded (BrdU neuronal survival, cell counting, neurogenesis, dendritic analysis, slice physiology). All three candidates correctly returned an empty assays array.
Strain field merged to reflect both lines used (C57BL/6J wildtype and DCX-CreERT2::tdTom transgenic).
Dose normalization: 100 µg ICV total cannot be converted to mg/kg (intracerebroventricular bolus, not body-weight-scaled), so doses_mg_per_kg left empty per rubric.
